reason: Eventar has no skill for proving a Postgres row-lock or concurrent-write behaviour. The DB-05 lock test only counted after it saw connection B waiting on connection A's row lock; that check is the reusable rule, and the next race test (check-in, claim, cancel) needs the same proof.
A post-lock not-found guard survived the mutant run until a delete-while-waiting case was added. The skill's bite-check does not say that a pre-lock fixture cannot kill a post-lock guard.
